title: External Research Watchlist → EFC Graph Target Mapping + Cluster Synthesis (DRAFT)
purpose: Human-curated mapping from watchlist canonical keys to EFCValidation test_ids, gap_ids, or competing-framework relations, with AI-drafted per-cluster synthesis that Morten reviews. Consumed by the external_watchlist_to_graph parser AND by external_research_ledger_publisher for rendering EFC_External_Research_Ledger.html.
test_id_source: Neo4j EFCValidation nodes, 2026-04-18 snapshot (288 entries, 233 with non-null test_id)

audit_history.summary: Initial draft; 30 targets across 12 items (22 high / 7 medium / 0 low / 3 gap not_found).

Morten review round 1. Re-audited medium-confidence, downgraded 3 to low; added 2 high targets for 3×2pt; removed dual-target for competitor paper; probe_subtype annotations; gap_materialization blocked.

Dedicated External Research Ledger design. Per Morten 2026-04-18: synthesis happens AT CLUSTER LEVEL, not per-entry. 7 clusters grouping 12 watchlist items by theme. Each cluster has an AI-drafted cluster_commentary (2-4 sentences, disciplined wording — consistency ≠ confirmation) + verified_by_morten gate. Per-entry commentary NOT included (would duplicate efc_relevance without adding synthesis). Renderer refuses to publish unverified cluster commentary.

parser_safety_contract.pre_run_check: Parser MUST refuse execution while last_verified_by_morten is null. Write a single WARN log line and exit non-zero.
parser_safety_contract.edge_status_rule: high confidence → edge.status = 'confirmed'. medium/low → edge.status = 'proposed'. Only 'confirmed' edges count in downstream dashboards and syretest queries.
parser_safety_contract.graph_status_rule: If graph_status = 'not_found', parser MUST log and SKIP — never create implicit Gap/Test nodes from this file.
parser_safety_contract.authority_rule: This file is advisory. It never overrides explicit graph facts. If a Publication already has SUPPORTS/CONTRADICTS from elsewhere, parser adds INFORMS in parallel, does not replace.
parser_safety_contract.commentary_rendering_rule: external_research_ledger_publisher MUST check cluster_commentary.verified_by_morten per cluster. If false/null, render placeholder 'Cluster synthesis pending review' instead of draft text. Never publish AI-drafted commentary without Morten's explicit per-cluster approval.

confidence_scale.high: ledger_action or efc_relevance explicitly names a graph-known identifier
confidence_scale.medium: thematically clear; single plausible candidate and no equally strong alternative
confidence_scale.low: multiple plausible candidates OR indirect linkage — do not auto-confirm

kind_semantics.test: Publication informs or provides data for this EFCValidation. Proposed edge: (Publication)-[:INFORMS]->(EFCValidation)
kind_semantics.gap: Publication bears on resolution of this knowledge gap. Proposed edge: (Publication)-[:INFORMS_GAP]->(Gap) or BLOCKS_RESOLUTION_OF.
kind_semantics.framework: Publication represents a competing theoretical framework. Parser multi-labels as (:Publication:Framework) and creates (Publication)-[:COMPETES_WITH]->(Theory {canonical: 'EFC'}).

commentary_linguistic_policy.principle: Conservative wording at cluster level. Consistency is not confirmation. Use 'informs', 'tightens', 'constrains', 'challenges', 'suggests parallel direction', 'remains consistent with'. NEVER use 'supports', 'confirms', 'validates', 'proves' unless explicitly backed by a sealed blind test result in the graph.
commentary_linguistic_policy.length: 2-4 sentences per cluster. Longer goes in working notes, not the ledger.
red_flags_to_avoid: Collapsing competitor-overlap ('also predicted by holographic DE') into EFC-exclusive evidence
Asserting directionality (X supports Y) when mechanism is shared with competing frameworks

graph_status_legend.confirmed: Target node verified present in Neo4j at generation time
graph_status_legend.not_found: Target not found; parser logs warning and skips edge
graph_status_legend.not_applicable: Framework kind — implicit EFC Theory node, not a specific test/gap identifier

gap_materialization_note.interpretation: The three canonical gap_ids referenced in watchlist ledger_action do not exist in the graph under any label. Recommended next action: create them via docs/validation-ledger/data/ flow, NOT as a side-effect of this parser.

synthesis_clusters.description: Editorial groupings of watchlist items by theme. Each cluster has an AI-drafted cluster_commentary (2-4 sentences) that Morten reviews and approves. Renderer uses these as section leads in External Research Ledger, above the individual entries in that cluster. Cluster-level synthesis is the primary editorial layer — per-entry commentary intentionally omitted to avoid duplicating efc_relevance without adding synthesis.
synthesis_clusters.fill_workflow: Read draft. Edit or replace. Set verified_by_morten: true and verified_at: <ISO date>. Renderer then publishes.

clusters.name: DESI DR2 og dynamisk mørk energi (w₀wₐ)

cluster_commentary.draft: DESI DR2 viser 3.1σ preferanse for w₀wₐ over ren kosmologisk konstant, uavhengig reprodusert av Nature Astronomy's reanalyse. Retningen er kompatibel med EFCs L2→L3 regime-overgang og med α = −0.14 ± 0.21. Samme signal predikeres imidlertid også av holografisk mørk energi, kvintessens og flere andre rammeverk — feltet beveger seg vekk fra ΛCDM, men det velger ikke EFC framfor konkurrenter.

DES Y6 publiserer S8 ≈ 0.79 fra cosmic shear og 3×2pt — 2.4–2.7σ lavere enn Planck+ACT+SPT (0.836), mens KiDS-Legacy sitter nær Planck. 2026-review-paperet konsoliderer bildet: probe-splittelsen er reell, ikke en artefakt. EFCs pre-registrerte DES Y6 P3 PASS (0.944 ± 0.018) og μ(a)<1-prediksjon overlever de publiserte tallene, men den observerte tensjonen har flere mulige forklaringer enn EFC — inkludert baryonisk feedback, intrinsic alignment-systematikk og andre μ<1-modeller.

Felles ACT+SPT+Planck CMB-lensing oppnår S8 = 0.825 ved 1.6% presisjon (SNR 61). Presisjonen er forbi det EFCs nåværende Boltzmann-baserte pipeline håndterer numerisk. Dette gjør theory-efclass-boltzmann-solver-gapet blokkerende for videre EFC-konkurranse i denne regimen: uten produksjonsklar hi_class-integrasjon kan EFC ikke møte dette presisjonsnivået head-to-head.

To uavhengige JWST-masserekonstruksjoner av Bullet Cluster er nå tilgjengelige: 146 SL-constraints + tette WL-data (Cha/Jee) og 135 multiple images (Rihtaršič/Bradač). EFCs pre-registrerte δκ shock-front-test (figshare 31963668) har dermed det den trenger av observasjonelt datagrunnlag. Flaskehalsen er internal EFC-pipeline, ikke data — leveringsansvaret ligger hos oss, ikke feltet.

BIG-SPARC utvider rotasjonskurve-datagrunnlaget forbi SPARC-175. Parallelt presenterer arXiv:2601.00522 en ny empirisk modell som hevder å overgå både MOND og CDM-haloer. Begge peker mot samme neste-skritt: kjøre Kill-Test v6 universalitet på utvidet data, og deretter ΔAIC-sammenligning mot denne konkurrenten. Ingen EFC-analyser har kjørt mot disse nye ressursene ennå.

Euclid DR1 (2100 deg² cosmic shear) lander 2026-10-21 og forventes å arbitrere mellom DES Y6 og KiDS-Legacy S8-uenigheten. EFC har forseglet pre-registrert pipeline (figshare 31990053, B0=0.02, M0=0.06). Ingen retnings-vurdering skal skrives før DR1 faktisk er offentliggjort — dette er en reell blind-test, ikke en konsistenssjekk.

Informational Entropic Gravity (2026-preprint) er den nærmeste ontologiske slektningen til EFC publisert i årets litteratur — alternativ formulering av gravitasjon som makroskopisk informasjonslikevekt på holografiske grenser. arXiv:2601.00522 representerer en empirisk konkurrent på rotasjonskurve-fronten. Begge krever formell recovery-conditions-sammenligning (WP1) og head-to-head ΔAIC-evaluering før vi kan vurdere dem. Dette er posisjoner EFC må velges over, ikke bare konsistenssjekker.
cluster_commentary.note: arXiv:2601.00522 er med i to klynger bevisst — datacluster (#5) og competing-frameworks (#7). Renderer bør vise cross-link.

review_workflow: 1. Read each synthesis_clusters.clusters[].cluster_commentary.draft. Edit, replace, or keep. When satisfied set verified_by_morten: true and verified_at: <ISO date>.
2. Resolve 3 low-confidence items (same as v0.2 unchanged).
3. Decide gap_id materialization (3 gaps not_found) — create via ledger-update or remove.
4. When all above complete: set top-level last_verified_by_morten + bump version to 1.0. Parser and ledger-publisher may then run.
high_priority_review_points: 7 cluster_commentary drafts — this is the primary review surface. Each is 2-4 sentences, conservative wording. Replace any that miss the framing you want.
3 gap_ids graph-absent — Alt B decision needed
